title: P4.6-M suspected shabu, smuggled cigarettes seized in BARMM

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — Authorities seized suspected shabu worth P3.4 million and allegedly smuggled cigarettes valued at more than P1.24 million, or a total of P4.6 million, in separate operations in Tawi-Tawi and Maguindanao del Sur in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) on Oct. 16 and 17, respectively. Brig. Gen. Christopher Abecia, regional director of the Police Regional Office in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region (PRO-BAR), said a joint team from the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA), Bongao Municipal Police Station and the 4th Marine Rifle Battalion confiscated about 500 grams of suspected shabu worth P3.4 million in Barangay Poblacion, […]...
